title: Rolling back a failed deploy
body: Use the previous release tag and redeploy. Check the health endpoint after the rollout finishes.

title: Deploy checklist
body: Before a deploy confirm migrations, feature flags and the rollback plan. A failed deploy should be rolled back within minutes.

title: Database failover runbook
body: Promote the replica when the primary stops answering. Update the connection string and verify replication lag.

title: Renewing TLS certificates
body: Certificates expire every 90 days. Run the renewal job and reload the proxy to pick up the new certificate.

title: On-call handoff
body: Summarise open incidents, pending deploys and any failed jobs for the next engineer.

title: Disk full on build agents
body: Prune old images and caches. A full disk makes deploys and builds fail with confusing errors.

title: API rate limits
body: Clients receive 429 when over quota. Retry with exponential backoff and jitter.

title: Rotating secrets
body: Rotate database passwords and API keys quarterly. Restart services after rotation so they load new values.

title: Searching logs
body: Filter by correlation id first. Deploy markers appear in the timeline to help correlate regressions.

title: DNS outage playbook
body: Check the resolver, then the zone. Fall back to the secondary provider if records fail to resolve.

title: Flushing the cache
body: Evicting keys causes a spike on the database. Flush one shard at a time and watch latency.

title: Scaling queue workers
body: Add workers when queue depth stays high. Each worker holds a database connection so watch the pool size.
